
```{python}
import pandas as pd
import os


back_dir = os.path.normpath(os.getcwd() + os.sep + os.pardir)
two_back_dir = os.path.normpath(back_dir + os.sep + os.pardir)
csv1_path= os.path.join(two_back_dir,'outputs','gbif_species_match_638_clean.csv')
csv2_path= os.path.join(os.getcwd(),f'gbif_species_match_638_clean.csv')

df1 = pd.read_csv(csv1_path)
df2 = pd.read_csv(csv2_path)
```
